title: The Garden of Maple Hollow
author: Astrid Winterbourne
blurb: Quentin Sandoval, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. But when a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
